---
title: "explore"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)

url1 <- "https://paddlestats.net/json/course/adk90_day1_OF_to_BML"
day1json <- read_json(url1, simplifyVector = TRUE)

columns <- c("year", "raceId", "boatType", "classId", "place", "value")

day1 <- day1json$results |> as_tibble() |> 
  select(any_of(columns))

url2 <- "https://paddlestats.net/json/course/adk90_day2_LLB_to_CRS"
day2json <- read_json(url2, simplifyVector = TRUE)

day2 <- day2json$results |> as_tibble() |> 
  select(any_of(columns))

url3 <- "https://paddlestats.net/json/course/adk90_day3_FC_to_SL"
day3json <- read_json(url3, simplifyVector = TRUE)

day3 <- day3json$results |> as_tibble() |> 
  select(any_of(columns))
```

```{r}
write_csv(day1, "day1.csv")
write_csv(day2, "day2.csv")
write_csv(day3, "day3.csv")
```
